conf.description: Veritas NetBackup audit REST /security/auditlogs (JSON), direct route. Deliberately thin per recommendations.direct.cribl (parse_location: high) which defers field flattening/resolution to the Elastic ingest pipeline; this pipeline only extracts JSON, sets _time from auditTime, and tags event.dataset

conf.comment: NetBackup audit REST /security/auditlogs (JSON), direct route. recommendations.direct.cribl for this format states parse_location=high and explicitly defers flattening auditUserIdentity/auditRecordAttributeList and resolving CATEGORY/ACTION to the Elastic logs-veritas_netbackup.audit ingest pipeline -- 'there is no need to shape low-side'. Per the brief, this recommendation outranks the generic build recipe, so this pipeline is deliberately thin: JSON extract, _time, event.dataset. Credential/token masking the recommendation calls for is a documented gap (no algorithm given).

functions.description: Pipeline purpose and why this one is intentionally minimal
Event time from auditTime (epoch milliseconds) into _time, not @timestamp (platform constraint)
Set event.dataset (no hyphen, platform constraint) -- shared with the syslog-raw and OCSF branches
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
